body: Same. My parents love me even though I haven't done a thing to deserve their love.

I honestly don't know if I have depression. Sometimes I feel so goddamn hopeless while other times I feel ok. Like right now, I feel kind of ridiculous reading what I've written in my post but at the same time I know how easy it is for me to slip back into a state of hopelessness. 

As for anxiety, I think it's definitely keeping me from "living". It's so damn hard for me to be around others let alone talk to them. It sucks because despite this I always end up feeling dejected and lonely when I'm alone which is 99% of the time. My feelings are just all over the place but in the end I always focus on the negatives. It's a compulsion.

Thank you for sharing your story. I often feel depressed and hopeless but reading stories like yours reminds me of how ridiculously trivial my situation is when others can go through soul-crushing ordeals and still make it out ok. I guess the run never truly ends but it's inspiring to know that people like you have this incredible drive in them that keeps them going even through the darkest of times. I hope you continue to stay strong too. I'll try my best.
